title: Compact object in a triangulated category
statement: Let C be an additive category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with arbitrary coproducts. An object K of C is compact if, for every set I and family (E_i)_{i in I}, the canonical map \bigoplus_{i in I} Hom_C(K,E_i) \to Hom_C(K,\bigoplus_{i in I} E_i) is bijective.
